text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
while out with Rose Kingdom——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed Rose Kingdom's gaze.
There stood a crane game filled with
plushies
modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in Paka Puchi?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is thoroughly magnificent.
It captures the model's features
splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
such loveliness is quite soothing to
behold.
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you, if you'd...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruler told me this takes skill.
You needn't push yourself beyond your
limits.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I must admit,
I am somewhat curious to see it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no—
please pretend you didn't hear that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I cannot afford to lose this match!!
